Used by `tests/acceptance/2026-05-03-generate-sprints-skill/us-004-*.test.sh`.
Carries FOUR `### US-` blocks that the synthesis stage MUST realize across
its produced task list (every US covered by ≥1 task).

## User Stories

### US-001 — Pre-flight foundation

As a Yoke user, I want pre-flight checks to gate the skill before any
mutation, so misuse fails loudly.

#### Definition of Done

- [ ] Pre-flight composes provider + slug + spec + AC checks.
- [ ] Pre-flight emits wm:-prefixed stderr on every failure mode.

#### Acceptance Criteria

- **AC-001-1:** Pre-flight refuses on missing config.
- **AC-001-2:** Pre-flight refuses on un-ratified AC.

### US-002 — Input parsers

As a Yoke user, I want the AC and Spec parsed into JSON, so the
synthesis stage has a structured input.

#### Definition of Done

- [ ] AC parser emits `user_stories` array.
- [ ] Spec parser emits `objective` + `contracts`.

#### Acceptance Criteria

- **AC-002-1:** AC parser exits 0 on valid input.
- **AC-002-2:** Spec parser exits 0 on valid input.

### US-003 — Synthesis stage

As a Yoke user, I want a synthesized task list realizing every US, so
no US is left orphan.

#### Definition of Done

- [ ] Every US is realized by ≥1 task.
- [ ] Synthesis aborts when a US is unrealized.

#### Acceptance Criteria

- **AC-003-1:** Tasks list non-empty post-synthesis.
- **AC-003-2:** Skill aborts with `wm: unrealized USs:` on coverage gap.

### US-004 — Plan persistence

As a Yoke user, I want the synthesized plan persisted to disk, so the
partition stage has a durable input.

#### Definition of Done

- [ ] Plan written to .yoke/runtime/.generate-sprints-plan.yaml.
- [ ] Plan contains the synthesized tasks array.

#### Acceptance Criteria

- **AC-004-1:** Plan file exists post-synthesis.
- **AC-004-2:** Plan contains `tasks:` non-empty.

## Functional Requirements

- **FR-1:** Every produced task lists ≥1 US it realizes.
- **FR-2:** Plan is YAML with `tasks` and `sprint_partition` arrays.
